description: This Java class SensorLogger manages logging sensor data for an automotive ECU system. It initializes log files, writes sensor values periodically to the log, and handles file creation and sensor data formatting based on debug modes.

classes.name: SensorLogger
classes.description: A logger class for periodically writing sensor data to a log file, with initialization and sensor value retrieval, managing file creation, and formatting based on debug mode.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor logger ensuring it starts listening for sensor updates and logs data if connected.

methods.name: writeSensorLogLine
methods.description: Writes the current sensor values to the log file with timestamp.

methods.name: startSensorLogFile
methods.description: Creates and initializes the log file, writes headers and sensor names.

methods.name: getSensorName
methods.description: Returns the sensor's display name, possibly altered depending on debug mode.

methods.name: isPidDebugMode
methods.description: Determines if the current debug mode is related to PID tuning based on predefined values.
